content.title: Inside Rory McIlroy's love life and 'realisation' after filing for divorce from Erica Stoll
content.text: Rory McIlroy is one of the most popular golfers in the world and has been linked to a number of high-profile women over the years - here, Belfast Live breaks down his love lifeRory McIlroy clinched the elusive Masters title on Sunday, with the 35-year-old Holywood native finally shaking off his Augusta jinx and completing a career Grand Slam.Yet, like many sporting greats, McIlroy's personal life often steals the spotlight. Roughly 11 months ago, the golfing community was left stunned when McIlroy filed for divorce from his wife of seven years, Erica Stoll, just days before the US PGA Championship.However, a month later, the couple announced they had "resolved differences" and wouldn't be separating. Since his ascent to golfing fame in 2009, McIlroy has been linked to several high-profile women.Here, we delve into Rory's love life - from whispers of a romance with Meghan Markle to his brief engagement to former world number one tennis star Caroline Wozniacki...Meghan Markle rumoursBefore Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, found her fairytale ending with Prince Harry, she was rumoured to have a connection with McIlroy. Back in the summer of 2014, when Markle was riding high on her Suits fame, she struck up an unlikely friendship with the professional golfer, reports the Mirror US.Romance speculation began circulating after McIlroy nominated Markle for the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge - a viral sensation where participants drenched themselves in icy water and posted the footage online to raise awareness for ALS, a motor neurone disease. Markle agreed to participate on one condition - that McIlroy would be the one to pour the icy water over her.Following the video's release on social media, the two reportedly met for drinks and dinner in New York. Not long after, Markle wrote about McIlroy on her former blog, The Tig, labelling him the "real deal". She wrote: "Ah yes. Rory McIlroy. THE Rory McIlroy. Whispered (and shouted) to be the foremost golfer in the world, loved by Tiger [Woods], respected by [Arnold] Palmer, and dumper of frigid water on to my lone head for the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge. That Rory McIlroy."She continued: "He is a force who has the propensity to actually work hard and play hard - relishing intense practices to substantiate his title, embracing nights of sipping Opus One (his bold and impressive choice of wine) and indulging in group dinners at Cipriani - for the balance, of course."And yet, beyond his work/play ethic, the most endearing quality of this man is his character - as real and honest as they come, appreciating a simple smile, never shunning a fan photo, enjoying a plate of pasta with veal ragu, and expressing a love for his parents that is rarely seen in men his age. Or at any age, to be honest. He is not just the real deal... he is real. And perhaps that is what makes him even more cherished."Speculation of a romance lit up when, later on, in October 2014, they were spotted during a dinner at Dublin's trendy Fade Street Social. Despite intense speculation, it was reported that sources close to Markle insisted the pair were only good friends.Caroline Wozniacki engagement called offThe engagement between McIlroy and former tennis ace Wozniacki looked set for success after their three-year courtship culminated in a festive proposal in December 2013. Yet the journey to happily ever after took a shocking turn when McIlroy abruptly called off the engagement.According to The Times, a brief phone conversation, reportedly lasting only three minutes and initiated by McIlroy, spelt the end for Wozniacki, who at first thought it nothing but a cruel joke. McIlroy didn't hold back in his reflections on his previous relationship, which led to a fiery dialogue with his ex.Speaking to the Irish Independent back in 2017, he said: "I thought at the time that being with someone that was in a similar position to you was the obvious answer. But it isn't, because you can never get away from it. You can never detach yourself and try to come back to the real world."Marrying Erica StollAfter ending his previous engagement, Rory quickly found love again with Erica Stoll. Their paths had first crossed in 2012 when she worked with the PGA of America.The couple's wedding in 2017 was held at the illustrious Ashworth Castle in Ireland, where they celebrated among stars, with personalities like Chris Martin from Coldplay and One Direction’s Niall Horan in attendance. Music icons Stevie Wonder and Ed Sheeran provided the soundtrack for the star-studded affair.In August 2020, the couple welcomed their daughter, Poppy Kennedy McIlroy, to the world. Rory spoke once more with the Irish Independent, lauding Erica for her down-to-earth demeanour while subtly taking a swipe at his former partner.He said: "We met when she was working for the PGA of America, and renting a condo in Palm Beach, and I found it refreshing being with someone who was living a normal life rather than, 'Oh! My jet is 30 minutes late!'."I could speak to her about anything, we ended up spending a bit of time together and realised that there was something more there. I love that she knows everything about me, and there was no judgement there. There was no judgement from day one, which is huge, because that's very hard to find for someone in my position."A divorce filingHowever, the seemingly perfect marriage hit a rough patch when it emerged that Rory had filed for divorce after seven years together. The papers were lodged at Palm Beach County State Court in Florida on Monday, May 13, 2024.A statement from McIlroy's communications team confirmed the filing: "Rory McIlroy's communications team confirmed today that a divorce has been filed," it read. "They stressed Rory's desire to ensure this difficult time is as respectful and amicable as possible. He will not be making any further comment."But in a twist, just a month later, reports surfaced that Rory had retracted his divorce application, with the Daily Mail revealing that Erica hadn't responded or appointed an attorney by the June 2 deadline. Two days before teeing off at the U.S. Open, McIlroy put an end to the speculation, confirming that they had patched things up.In a statement given to the Guardian, he said: "There have been rumours about my personal life recently, which is unfortunate. Responding to each rumour is a fool's game. Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning."Links with Amanda BalionisSpeculation had been rife about McIlroy's personal life, particularly after he was seen sharing a hug with CBS Sports reporter Amanda Balionis, 38, following an interview at the RBC Canadian Open in Hamilton, Ontario. Despite being married to football coach Bryn Renner, Balionis was spotted without her wedding ring and had returned to using her maiden name.The couple kept silent on the rumours of a split. Neither Balionis nor McIlroy addressed the gossip surrounding them while sources denied they were romantically involved.Looking aheadMcIlroy appeared keen to put the gossip to rest, especially when his family joined him in celebration after he walked off the course at the DP World Tour Championship. He was seen embracing his young daughter joyfully before sharing a kiss with Stoll.At the post-tournament presentation on the 18th green, he took a moment to honour his family, telling Erica and Poppy: "I love you," during his victory speech. An emotional McIlroy also opened up about the personal struggles he had endured throughout the past year.He said: "Yeah It means a lot," adding: "I've been through a lot this year professionally, personally. It feels like the fitting end to 2024. You know, yeah, look, I've persevered this year a lot. Had close calls. Wasn't able to get it done... Really pleased with the way I finished and thankfully I hung on on a tough day and got it done."
